_comment: refresh_resources.py 가 생성 결과 위에 마지막으로 덮어쓰는 손 보정 (갱신해도 유지된다).
settings.<경로>: SettingInfo 필드(scope 는 'user|managed' 문자열, since/removed/deprecated_since 는 버전 문자열) + schema(그 경로의 JSON 스키마 — 주입 또는 교체).
env.<NAME>: env-vars.json 항목 필드(description, values, inSchema, inDocs …). 공식 스키마·문서에 아직 없는 변수를 여기 둔다.

taskOutputMaxChars._note: v2.1.277 에서 제거되어 문서에 Type 이 없다. CHANGELOG: TaskOutput 도구 출력 글자 수 상한.

options.description: The rows the picker shows, in this order.

model.description: Model alias or ID the row selects.

label.description: Row title. Defaults to the built-in name or the model ID.

description.description: Second line shown under the label.

behavesAs.description: Built-in model whose capabilities this row's model follows.

replaceBuiltInOptions.description: Show only these rows (plus Default and the current model) instead of adding them after the built-in lineup.

multiplier.description: Scales every cost Claude Code computes. Below 1 is a discount, above 1 a markup.

overrides.description: USD-per-million-token rates per model ID; all four rates required.

maxEffortLevel.description: The highest effort level the model may run at.

autoCompactWindow.description: Tokens from 100000 to 1000000, or "auto" for the window tuned for the model.

language.description: Dictionary name passed to the checker.

color.description: Terminal color name, #rrggbb, rgb(r,g,b), ansi256(n), or ansi:<name>.

command.description: Program and plain arguments; Desktop starts it without a shell.

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS._note: Claude Mods(Function hook) 활성화 플래그. 공식 스키마·문서에는 아직 미등재.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DR._note: CHANGELOG 2.1.316 에서 추가. env 문서 미등재.
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DR.description: Set to 1 to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one. Requires Claude Code v2.1.316 or later

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK._note: CHANGELOG 2.1.316 에서 추가. env 문서 미등재.
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK.description: Set to 1 to turn the ultrathink keyword off. Requires Claude Code v2.1.316 or later

CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT._note: CHANGELOG 2.1.316 에서 추가. env 문서 미등재. 값은 CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL 의 effort 단계.
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT.description: Set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's. Values: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Requires Claude Code v2.1.316 or later

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID._note: CHANGELOG 2.1.317 에서 추가. env 문서 미등재.
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID.description: Set to 1 on a self-hosted runner to have claude -p run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions. Requires Claude Code v2.1.317 or later

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS._note: CHANGELOG 2.1.319 에서 언급. env 문서 미등재.
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS.description: Set to 1 to turn off MCP tasks, which since v2.1.319 also work without feature-flag fetching (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways, DISABLE_TELEMETRY)

CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE._note: CHANGELOG 2.1.319 에서 언급. env 문서 미등재.
CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE.description: Set to 1 to keep the old self-paced /loop behavior of scheduling a fallback wakeup when a turn finishes without rescheduling, instead of ending the loop. Requires Claude Code v2.1.319 or later
